title: Staccato Growth Threads Notebook
content:
Purpose: quick, modular thinking buffer for mid-quarter calibration + manager sync. Not polished — intentionally fragmented so I can capture micro-evidence and micro-asks.

High-level thesis (one-line): shift from reactive ops tickets to 3 measurable investments that lift org bandwidth: onboarding friction reduction, manager enablement playbook, and a lightweight growth mentoring loop.

5 headline priorities (5–6 week horizon):
1) Onboarding friction: identify top 3 drop-off points in week 1 (docs, infra access, first PR). Evidence: new-hire survey n=18, avg time-to-first-merge = 9.2 days. Goal = 4d.
   - Quick wins: pre-provision token for infra, checklist template for repos.
   - Metric: days to first merge; measure weekly.

2) Manager enablement: pilot 6 managers with a 30-min "calibration hour" + 1 pager. Evidence: inconsistent feedback seen in last calibration; 4 calibration misses flagged. Goal = reduce calibration variance by 20%.
   - Ask: 4 cross-team calibration artifacts from product/eng to reference.

3) Growth mentoring loop: run 8 mentee cycles (8 people) 1:1s with matched mentor + 8wk micro-sprints. Evidence: anecdotal win rate high in early trials. Goal = 60% mentees report tangible signal (project shipped, skill improved).

4) Comp clarity doc: iterate comp ladder excerpt for IC4->IC5 bridging examples. Evidence: repeated manager questions in Q1. Quick artifact: 1-page "what good looks like".

5) Micro-experiments: run two low-cost experiments this month — (A) retro template that asks for 3 lessons + 1 micro-ask; (B) async calibration pad where managers post 3 calibration samples. Measure adoption.

Signals I care about (leading indicators):
- Weekly NPS from new hires (pulse), look for +10pts by end of sprint.
- Time-to-first-merge trending down.
- Number of calibration misses flagged in monthly review.
- Mentorship loop completions and qualitative wins logged.

Companion evidence log (short bullets):
- 2026-01-28 new-hire pulse: confusion 1: access to infra (12/18), 2: unclear first project (8/18)
- 2026-02-03 manager calibration thread: 4 flagged edge-cases on promotion bar
- Slack DM with Priya: agreement to pilot 6 managers (Priya -> will recruit)

Manager prep: upcoming sync (Mar 14)
- 3 asks (explicit):
  1) Support to block 1-2 engineering hours for onboarding checklist implementation (2 devs, 6-8 hours each).
  2) Endorsement to include "time-to-first-merge" as product onboarding KPI for Q2.
  3) Permission to run the mentor loop pilot with opt-in from product managers.
- Calibration bullets to surface: two borderline promo cases (anon IDs), suggested evidence chunks (PR impact, cross-team influence, mentorship).
- Two manager questions to bring: where are we comfortable loosening tech bar vs. comp alignment? And what are guardrails for rapid promotions?

Self-reflection (raw):
- Bias to action is helpful but sometimes creates fragmented follow-up. Need to own fewer experiments with clearer measurement.
- Strength: synthesis; Weakness: follow-through on plumbing (eg tracking dashboards).

Micro-tasks (next 7 days):
- Draft onboarding checklist template (due Mar 16) — TODO: borrow from eng infra doc (link above).
- Email Priya with mentor loop roster and matching criteria (Mar 13).
- Build a simple spreadsheet (cols: hire, start date, first-merge, blocker note) and share with SRE.

Notes-to-self:
- Keep artifacts <1 page when possible. Executives prefer signal, not narrative.
- For calibration, present 3 exemplar cases: clear yes, clear no, question-case.

Possible risks & mitigations:
- Risk: dev time for onboarding checklist gets deprioritized. Mitigation: ask for a 1-week volunteer sprint; offer recognition in all-hands.
- Risk: low mentor sign-ups. Mitigation: seed with senior ICs who want coaching experience + small recognition token.

Loose timeline (6 weeks):
Week 1: recruit pilots, draft checklist, set metrics
Week 2–3: run mentor pairings, begin onboarding fixes, collect early pulses
Week 4: interim calibration, collect data, iterate
Week 5–6: close pilot, prepare 1-page outcomes for manager sync (and exec 5-min brief)

Quick artifacts to produce (deliverables):
- 1-pg onboarding checklist + playbook
- 1-pg manager calibration playbook (with 3 sample cases)
- Mentor-loop sign-up + matching sheet
- 5-min slide: outcomes + ask for Mar leadership sync

Random sparks (brain dump):
- Could we embed a "first week buddy" microbadge in Slack that grants access and a short checklist?
- Consider making mentoring time part of manager OKRs to increase supply.

End note: keep this doc intentionally messy. When I prep the manager deck, I will extract the top 3 evidence bullets and the two asks.

Last quick log: 2026-03-12: exported N=6 responses from new-hire pulse — access issue persistent; flagged to infra.

---
Small, digestible, repeated experiments > big single monolith. Use gate-and-measure approach.
